patch_description:
The current program (score 0.40) has poor worst-group margin (0.24) and high generalization gap (0.24). The prior Gen 2 (score 0.54) achieved better worst-group margin (0.31) through heterogeneity despite having 12 distinct params.

Since I cannot modify `apply_ansatz_block` (it's outside EVOLVE-BLOCK), I will use a different strategy: define ANSATZ_SPEC with a three-level hierarchical parameter pattern (A, B, C) such that when the same spec is applied three times with identical parameters, the gate sequences naturally create heterogeneous effective circuits due to repeated application of different gate types at different positions.

**Strategy:**
- Use 3-way parameter rotation (ry_a, ry_b, ry_c on RY gates)
- Use 3-way parameter rotation (zz_a, zz_b, zz_c on ZZ gates) 
- Create staggered entanglement patterns so repeated application is non-uniform
- Total ~9-10 distinct parameters (lean, parameter-efficient)

This breaks the symmetry of the three repetitions without needing block_index logic, by making the circuit structure itself non-symmetric across the 8 qubits and gate types.
